"REALISTIC DRIVING SIMULATOR 3D

Create a highly realistic 3D open-world driving simulator.

1. MAIN MENU

- Play button
- Garage
- Car selection
- Truck selection
- Settings
- Graphics settings
- Sound settings
- Map selection

Make a beautiful realistic main menu with animated cars.

2. VEHICLE GARAGE

Include a vehicle selection menu.

CARS:

1. Sports car
2. Supercar
3. Lamborghini-style car
4. Ferrari-style car
5. Sedan
6. SUV
7. Pickup truck
8. Electric car
9. Racing car
10. Luxury car

TRUCKS:

1. Cargo truck
2. Heavy transport truck
3. Delivery truck
4. Dump truck
5. Bus
6. Trailer truck
7. Fuel tanker truck

Every vehicle must have different speed, acceleration, weight, braking and handling.

3. REALISTIC DRIVING CONTROLS

Create fully working controls:

- Steering wheel that rotates when touched or dragged.
- Accelerator pedal.
- Brake pedal.
- Reverse gear.
- Gear selector: P, R, N, D.
- Manual gear shifting: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.
- Handbrake.
- Turn signals.
- Headlights.
- Horn.
- Dashboard speedometer.
- RPM meter.
- Fuel meter.
- Engine temperature.
- Working mirrors.

Make the steering wheel and pedals work properly on mobile.

4. DIFFERENT CAMERA MODES

- First-person cockpit camera.
- Realistic driver camera.
- Third-person camera.
- Front camera.
- Side camera.
- Free camera.

5. REAL PERSON MODE

Create a realistic human driver mode.

- A realistic 3D human character.
- Character can enter and exit cars.
- Character can walk around.
- Character can open car doors.
- Character can sit in the driver's seat.
- Character can walk around petrol stations.
- Character can explore the city.
- Character can enter and exit trucks.

6. MAPS AND ROADS

MAP 1: CITY

- Traffic lights.
- Buildings.
- Pedestrians.
- Parking areas.
- Petrol stations.
- Realistic traffic.

MAP 2: HIGHWAY

- Multiple lanes.
- AI cars and trucks.
- Road signs.
- Speed limits.
- Bridges.
- Tunnels.

MAP 3: STEEP MOUNTAIN ROAD

- Very steep uphill roads.
- Dangerous-looking but safe-to-drive curves.
- Downhill roads.
- Mountain scenery.
- Narrow roads.
- Realistic elevation.

MAP 4: COUNTRY ROADS

- Villages.
- Farms.
- Small roads.
- Trees.
- Bridges.

MAP 5: OFF-ROAD

- Mud roads.
- Rocky roads.
- Hills.
- Dirt tracks.

7. REALISTIC PHYSICS

- Realistic vehicle suspension.
- Working tires.
- Realistic acceleration.
- Realistic braking.
- Vehicle weight affects handling.
- Realistic engine sounds.
- Gear shifting animations.
- Tire sounds.
- Weather effects.
- Day and night cycle.
- Rain and fog.

8. GAME FEATURES

- Free driving mode.
- Parking challenges.
- Highway driving missions.
- Truck delivery missions.
- Driving school.
- Fuel stations.
- Vehicle damage.
- Repair garages.
- Save progress.
- Vehicle customization.
- Paint and wheel customization.

9. GRAPHICS

Use high-quality realistic 3D graphics.
Add realistic shadows, reflections, lighting, roads, buildings, trees, clouds and vehicle interiors.

10. MOBILE SUPPORT

- Landscape screen.
- Touch steering wheel.
- Working pedals.
- Gear buttons.
- Smooth camera movement.
- Adjustable graphics.
- Stable performance.

IMPORTANT:
Make every button functional. Do not create fake controls. Build a playable 3D driving simulator with realistic vehicles, working gears, working steering, a human character and multiple explorable maps. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
